purpose: Selection record for j-direction unrolling in the FP32 oct remainder-row loop

baseline.description: Merged oct remainder rows, four-row column pairs and oct attend scoring

candidate.description: The eight-column remainder loop unrolls the input dimension four elements per iteration, computing each product into a temporary before the sequential accumulator add, preserving each output's ascending accumulation order.

kernel_results.median_ratio_summary: vs oct baseline across three fresh processes: workers1 decode shapes ~0.57-0.69, workers4 ~0.69-0.86; five-row mixed ~0.93-0.99. Identical outputs.

generation_results.median_ratio_summary: ~0.97-0.98x on 128-token decode, ~0.98x on outputs8, ~1.00x on long-prefill one-token; every completion identical.

note: An earlier variant summing four products in one expression changed rounding and failed bit-exact tests; only sequential per-element adds are used.
limitations: Single host/model; decode-share gains shrink as other paths already dominate
portability_note: CI caught a NaN-payload difference on amd64: operand ordering inside differently shaped kernels changes which NaN payload propagates. Products are computed into temporaries and the special-bits test compares NaN lanes as NaN (payloads are not IEEE-guaranteed); all non-NaN lanes remain bit-exact.
